summary.intent: Continue autonomous orchestration of CipherBox v2 wave 8/9 development: drive a fleet of sub-agents building PRs toward a demonstrable end-to-end vertical slice (login → provision vault → create/upload → read back), managing CodeRabbit's one-review-per-hour ceiling, GitHub issue hygiene, and cross-repo ADR decisions in cipher-box-next.
summary.outcome: Landed the owner-pseudonym-seed KDF edge, production OwnerScopeKeys, first-run vault provisioning (#1219), manual refresh, an owner-local sealed store primitive, and multiple rotation/drain security fixes; established the true critical path to a demo, drafted two ADRs (0006 merged, 0007 proposed), fixed several review-cycle tooling bugs, and cleaned up stale worktrees/branches — while also fixing a gap in the /resolve-pr-reviews skill that caused nitpick dispositions to go unposted on some PRs.

repo: A clean CodeRabbit verdict is a review on the head commit with a ZERO-LENGTH body, not a status-comment string — this was misdiagnosed for hours before being fixed.

Nitpicks live only in a review body's collapsible section with NO inline threads, so reviewThreads GraphQL queries and thread-based resolution flows cannot see them — cost 6 nitpicks missed on #1196, 3 on #1215, and a disposition comment missed on #1158.
CodeRabbit's final pre-merge review consumes the org-wide hourly slot, so merging a PR and flipping the next PR ready in the same hour always collide.
gh pr ready on an already-ready PR is a no-op; a refused PR needs gh pr ready --undo then re-flip.
Event order must come from the GitHub timeline API (issues/{n}/timeline), never from an agent's self-reported summary.
Squash-merged branches never read as merged to git — git branch -d and git merge-base --is-ancestor both fail; must gate on PR state via gh and use branch -D.
A running check-run has conclusion: "" (empty string), not null.
Contract Suite skips silently when CONTRACT_API_URL is unset, so cargo test --workspace can report green while covering none of it.
DHT-backed delegated router 404 means 'my walk found nothing' (a lookup miss), not authoritative absence of a record.

Unwired-plane pattern recurs repeatedly: production code (seal_repoint, publish_settings, OwnerScopeKeys, RefreshHintSource, run_tick_loop, all of desktop-seams) exists but every caller is behind #[cfg(test)], so tests stay green while the feature is unreachable.
mock-ipns-routing implements PUT but only advertised GET, OPTIONS in CORS, blocking every browser-origin IPNS write until provisioning first exercised it.
Agent-filed GitHub issues repeatedly arrive with only the v2-build label — no milestone, component label, or parent — a recurring hygiene gap requiring manual correction almost every time.

The /resolve-pr-reviews command's step 2 has a 'stop' condition that exits early when there are zero review threads, which a nitpick-only review always has — so the disposition-comment step was never reached for nitpick-only reviews.

code.finding: require_vacant_vault_pointer implements a refuse-only vacancy probe (API recovery cache 404 + every routing endpoint individually) to prevent minting a second genesis vault over an existing one; residual risk is a partial outage where a live endpoint answers 'no record' while a down endpoint holds the real one.

rejection_verdict maps RejectionReason exhaustively to Option<RefreshVerdict>, deliberately returning None for EpochBelowFloor because that condition is sweep-pending/self-healing, not a failure — folding it into Unreachable would report a normal condition as a retryable failure that retries can never clear.

every_enc_subkey_hpke_info_string_is_distinct originally compared against a hand-computed count (3 + kinds.len()) instead of infos.len(), which fails open: a newly added colliding info literal would pass undetected. Fixed to compare against infos.len() directly.
Doc comment corrected to state ephemeral reuse is a break only 'under one recipient key and info' (not just recipient key), matching the actual invariant in suite/hpke.rs:74.

The command's step 2 stop-on-zero-threads logic and step 7/8 structure never encoded a requirement to post a disposition comment for nitpicks/out-of-scope comments, causing that step to be silently skipped for nitpick-only reviews.

workflow: Piping a gate command through tail/tee in zsh yields the pipe's exit status, not the gate's — caught this masking bug on cargo test and clippy multiple times, and even on markdownlint while doing this fix.
${PIPESTATUS[0]} is empty in zsh (the array is $pipestatus), a second variant of the exit-code-masking trap.
When rebasing a PR whose review is imminent, verify via git worktree ref reset --hard origin/<branch> before rebasing — a stale worktree ref can silently drop commits.
Before removing a worktree/branch pair, check PR state (not git ancestry) since squash-merge breaks all git-native merged-detection.
A background review-cycle chain and its verdict watcher must be torn down together — an orphaned watcher polling a deleted log file waits forever and never notifies.

When an agent's assessment reverses itself mid-task (e.g., re-evaluating risk after deeper investigation), verify the new claim independently before relaying it rather than trusting either version at face value.

friction: Repeated false-all-clear failures across the session: empty API reads scored as zero, running checks scored as settled, dropped GitHub API pages scored as absent, masked pipe exit codes scored as success, and a fail-open cadence guard that turned an unreadable clock into 'flip immediately' — the same shape recurring at least 8 distinct times.
Intermittent GitHub API 'connection refused' errors throughout the session required retry loops on nearly every gh/api call.

CodeRabbit's per-PR review timing was repeatedly misjudged (verdict late vs. detection blind, rate-limit cause misattributed to a draft push vs. an already-ready PR, cadence widened on a false premise) leading to several corrected explanations to the user.
Macroscope (second review bot) was out of credits for the entire second half of the session, leaving CodeRabbit as the sole reviewer on several security-critical PRs (#1196, #1200, #1211).
Stale local API processes (10+ hours old) on ports 3000/3100 caused phantom test failures that looked like real regressions until diagnosed.
Agent branch-name collisions occurred when reusing a name from an already-merged PR's leftover worktree.
